power.awakened.velocity.desc: Run faster than anything alive. Sprinting builds Momentum, read on the bar as gears, and each gear you reach takes more of the world away.

awakened.velocity.hint: Overdrive is on, so running shifts you up through the gears your mastery has unlocked. Tap %s to drop a gear, hold it to shift up.
awakened.velocity.gear_hint: The bar under your stamina is Momentum. Running fills it into gears. Hold %s to shift up, tap it to shift down. The dimmed end is gears your mastery has not unlocked yet.

awakened.screen.setting_velocity_overdri: Your super speed, on from the start. ON: you run at your chosen gear while sprinting, build Momentum, and eat as many times faster as you run. The Overdrive key flips this same switch.
awakened.screen.setting_velocity_auto_ge: ON shifts up through your earned gears as you sprint and back down to your earned gear when you stop. OFF: gears change only on G (tap down, hold up) and stay where you put them. Holding G past your earned gear forces it, up to the highest gear your mastery has opened.
awakened.screen.setting_velocity_trail_d: Lightning trails behind you as you run. OFF hides it for everyone, not only you.
awakened.screen.setting_velocity_echoes_: Leaves afterimages behind you in gear 2 or higher and while you phase. OFF leaves none.
ability.awakened.overdrive.desc: Switch your super speed on or off. It is already on when you awaken, and while it runs you sprint at your chosen gear and build Momentum.
ability.awakened.phasing.desc: Hold to vibrate so fast that walls, mobs and arrows pass straight through you. Sneak to sink through the floor.
ability.awakened.static_bolt.desc: Hold to pour Momentum into a bolt of static, release to hurl it where you look. The longer you pour, the harder it lands.
ability.awakened.timeless.desc: Drop the world around you into slow motion while you keep your own speed. If it catches an enemy player, your teammates and pets in range slow too.
ability.awakened.speed_tunnel.desc: Run so fast you tear open a wormhole and dive in, steering with your look through walls and floors. The tunnel stays open behind you for others to run through.
power.awakened.kinetic_charger.desc: Everything you do builds Charge: moving, landing, getting hit and stomping in place. Your abilities spend it instead of stamina, and you can charge them for a bigger effect. No fall damage from mastery 5. Stamina gear gives you more Charge.

awakened.kinetic_charger.no_ammo_main_ha: Nothing throwable in your main hand

awakened.kinetic_charger.confirm_yes_tip: Make this choice. It cannot be undone
ability.awakened.kinetic_throw.desc: Hold and release to throw your main-hand item, which explodes on impact. Keep holding to spend up to 60 Charge for a bigger blast. Items that stack to 16 hit harder. Never tools or enchanted items.
ability.awakened.recoil_shot.desc: Fire a short blast where you aim and get pushed the opposite way. Hold to spend up to 30 Charge on a bigger blast and a longer push. No fall damage until you land.
ability.awakened.impact_strike.desc: Hold to pull your fist back, release to punch a wave of air that hits everything in front of you, hardest up close. Hold longer to spend up to 40 Charge on a bigger punch. Tap for a quick one.
ability.awakened.rupture_kick.desc: Hold and release to stomp the ground. It cracks open in a widening strip in front of you and throws everyone on it into the air. Hold longer to spend up to 40 Charge on a longer, wider crack.
ability.awakened.full_release.desc: Tap for +10%, sneak and tap for -10%. Hold for 100%, sneak and hold to turn it off. Each 10% costs 4 Charge plus 1 a second, for +4% speed, +6% jump, +8% melee, +5% to abilities and -2% damage taken.
awakened.screen.setting_kinetic_magnet_d: Dropped items and experience within 5 blocks drift to you. OFF stops the pull. Items another player threw are left alone for their first 5 seconds.
awakened.screen.setting_kinetic_main_han: Kinetic Throw only throws the item in your main hand. OFF lets it take from your off hand, hotbar and inventory too.

awakened.arbiter_summons.none: No Court of Judgment found near here.
item.awakened.prism.tooltip: Right-click as a Velocity runner to set your lightning colour. Uses up the Prism.
item.awakened.energy_bar.tooltip: I would not eat this if you're not a runner if I were you
item.awakened.web_gauntlets.tooltip: Wear them in the Gauntlets slot as a Spider to load web types beyond Splat.
item.awakened.adamantium_ingot.tooltip: Charge an Adamantium Infusion Tank with it, or ring an armour piece with 8 of them to plate it.
item.awakened.infusion_tank.tooltip: Climb in (right-click), charge it with Adamantium Ingots, then begin the bonding.
item.awakened.siege_altar.tooltip: Set it on a 3×3 crying-obsidian floor with an amethyst+glowstone pillar at each corner, under open sky. Right-click holding a relic to offer it and summon the Leviathan.
awakened.siege_altar.no_sky: The rift needs open sky above the altar.

awakened.siege_altar.offer: Offer a relic (right-click holding one) to summon the Leviathan.
item.awakened.cordon_core.tooltip: Dropped by the Leviathan. Craft it on top of two sticks to make a Cordon Spear.
item.awakened.relic_belt.tooltip: Right-click to wear it and open its relic slots. Relics only work in a worn belt, and it keeps your armor slots free.
awakened.relic.need_belt: You need a Relic Belt to use relics. Craft one (see the Recipes tab), then right-click it to wear it.
awakened.combat_mode.on: Combat Mode ON. Slot keys now fire instantly
awakened.combat_mode.off: Combat Mode OFF. Slot keys only select (Activate to fire)

awakened.relic.slots_full: Relic slots full. Manage them on the character screen.
awakened.relic.max_level: This relic is already at maximum level.
awakened.relic.need_two: Need two copies of that relic to merge.
relic.awakened.cond.when_wounded: (peaks near death, none at full health)
power.awakened.teleporter.desc: Blink short distances toward where you look, landing with a moment where nothing can touch you.
ability.awakened.blink.desc: Teleport a short distance toward where you look, stopping in front of anything in the way. Brief invulnerability and no fall damage on landing.
ability.awakened.phase_strike.desc: Blink to the enemy you're aiming at, up to 18 blocks away, and hit it on arrival.
ability.awakened.smoke_veil.desc: Vanish in a cloud that blinds and slows nearby enemies for 4 seconds, and blink clear of them.
ability.awakened.vanishing_drop.desc: Grab the enemy you're aiming at and drop it from up to 14 blocks up.
ability.awakened.phantom_flurry.desc: Flicker between nearby enemies for two seconds, hitting five times a second. Nothing can touch you while it runs.
power.awakened.geokinetic.desc: Bend the ground you stand on. The block under your feet decides what you throw. From mastery 10 you assemble a stone golem and pilot it from inside.
ability.awakened.rock_throw.desc: Stomp up to 3 chunks of earth in front of you, then punch one to hurl it at your crosshair. Needs solid ground, and they crumble if you walk away. Gravel scatters into 6 pellets, sand blinds.
ability.awakened.rock_throw.blocked: No room to raise a rock here
ability.awakened.upheave.desc: Erupt a pillar of stone. Aim at an enemy to launch them, or at the ground for a cover pillar. Sneak or look down to ride it up, then tap jump at the top to vault.
ability.awakened.fault_line.desc: Stomp to tear a ridge of rock forward 13 blocks, further with mastery, throwing up anything it crosses. Sneak to steer the crack toward your crosshair, then left-click to burst its head into 8 stone spikes.
ability.awakened.great_maul.desc: Drop a stone warhammer on the enemy you aim at. It pins them in place and hits anything beside them. The block they stand on changes the hit: stone staggers longest, sand blinds.
ability.awakened.stone_mech.desc: Assemble a stone golem and climb inside. It takes no knockback and no fall damage, jump lands a ground pound, and sneak exits. Hits drain your stamina instead of its health, and piloting costs 3 stamina a second.
ability.awakened.stone_mech.blocked: No room for the golem to rise
power.awakened.cryokinetic.desc: You freeze what you fight. Every ability you land stacks Frostbite, which keeps slowing and damaging the target after the ability ends.
ability.awakened.frost_nova.desc: Hold to breathe a cone of frost about 5 blocks ahead of you, damaging and slowing everything in it. Drains 12 stamina a second.
ability.awakened.cold_snap.desc: Throw a fast javelin of ice that flies dead straight, with no drop.
ability.awakened.frozen_solid.desc: Encase the enemy you are aiming at in ice for 3 seconds, up to 5 with mastery and Ability Power, leaving it with full Frostbite. Holds bosses too. Needs a target within 18 blocks.
ability.awakened.glacial_slide.desc: Hold to glide forward on a trail of ice. You sink slowly and can barely climb, and you take no fall damage. Drains 16 stamina a second.
ability.awakened.glacial_rampart.desc: A glacier surges 20 blocks ahead of you, freezing every enemy it reaches for 4 seconds. It stands for 12 seconds as a solid ramp you can walk up, then shatters.
power.awakened.spider.desc: Swing and zip on webs to get around. Web Strike hits harder the faster you are moving.
ability.awakened.web_swing.desc: Hold to swing, release to launch. After a release, crouch plus a direction to flip: up to 3 different tricks each add 10% to your next swing. Double-tap sprint high in the air to dive.
ability.awakened.web_shot.desc: Hold to spray webs at what you aim at, about four a second. Splat slows what it hits and stacks up to five times. Wearing the Web Gauntlets unlocks three more web types on the wheel.
ability.awakened.web_zip.desc: Aim at terrain to pull yourself to it, or at a mob or dropped item to pull it to you instead. The heavier the target the slower it comes. Aim at open sky to dash 14 blocks the way you look.
ability.awakened.web_strike.desc: Aim at an enemy and fire both lines to lunge in feet-first. Damage and knockback scale with your travel speed.
ability.awakened.web_wings.desc: Activate to spread the web wings, then jump in mid-air to glide like an Elytra. A firework rocket boosts you. A real Elytra blocks them.
power.awakened.shadow.desc: You fight with darkness. Every ability is stronger in the dark and weaker in daylight or near a torch, and so is every hit you land.
ability.awakened.shadow_blade.desc: Press to draw the Shadow Blade. Press again or right-click to throw a Shadow Slash, a piercing arc that grows in the dark, full size at mastery 12. It cannot be dropped or enchanted. Sneak+Activate puts it away.
item.awakened.shadow_blade.tooltip: Right-click to throw a Shadow Slash. Stronger the darker it is. It stays with you; Sneak+Activate to put it away.
ability.awakened.shadow_squeeze.desc: Hold to lift the enemy you aim at into the air. They take damage over time, and a player caught in it cannot use abilities. Stronger in the dark.
ability.awakened.shadow_meld.desc: Press to become a phantom. Nothing can hit or track you, and you walk through walls and ceilings; hold sneak to sink through floors. Obsidian and bedrock stop you. Bright light keeps you out.
ability.awakened.shadow_orb.desc: Hold to charge a dark orb overhead. Release early for a piercing bolt, halfway for a blast on impact, near full for a blast that leaves a shadow field. Charges faster and hits harder in the dark.
ability.awakened.devour.desc: Open a pit of shadow where you aim, up to 28 blocks out. Enemies caught in it sink and take damage for 4 seconds, or 8 in full darkness.
awakened.shadow.meld_eject: Too much light. You left the shadows.
awakened.shadow.meld_drained: Out of stamina. You left the shadows.
power.awakened.sun.desc: You get stronger the higher the sun is. You peak at noon, where you can reach The One, and are weak after dark. A roof only limits how big you grow.
ability.awakened.solar_ascension.desc: Hold to ascend, up to 4 steps. Each step costs 6 stamina and raises your health, resistance, speed and size. Sneak+Activate to come down. Needs the sun up or a Personal Sun.
ability.awakened.sun_orb.desc: Hold to gather a sun over your head, release to hurl it. A longer charge makes a bigger blast, and it charges faster the higher the sun is.
ability.awakened.sun_pillar.desc: Call down a pillar of sunfire on a spot up to 30 blocks away. It burns anything inside it for 10 seconds. Its size and damage scale with your sun level.
ability.awakened.solar_onslaught.desc: Lunge at the enemy you're looking at and pin it in place, then hold to beat it down with fast blows. Letting go ends it with a slam.
ability.awakened.personal_sun.desc: Summon your own sun overhead for 30 seconds. Within 18 blocks of it you can ascend at night or in the Nether, though only the Sun Axe takes you to The One.
awakened.sun.need_sun: Needs the sun in the sky
awakened.sun.axe_fail: You need to be in open daylight.
awakened.sun.axe_fail_power: Only a player with the Sun power can light it.
awakened.sun.axe_fail_early: Too soon. Hold it up until it lights.
item.awakened.sun_axe.tooltip: Holding it raises your sun-level ceiling, which makes every ability stronger.
item.awakened.dormant_core.tooltip: Made from a nether star. Part of the Sun Axe.
item.awakened.blank_sun_axe.tooltip: Hold right-click in daylight to turn it into the Sun Axe.
power.awakened.summoning.desc: Kill mobs to collect their souls, then raise them as minions. Minions out in the world drain your stamina, and a minion that dies is gone for good. Raised horses come saddled for you. Set your active soul in the soul menu (G).
ability.awakened.summon.desc: Raise your active soul as a minion where you aim. Tougher mobs cost more to raise and more to hold. Your minion cap grows with mastery.
ability.awakened.recall.desc: Bank the minion you aim at, or the nearest one, back into soul storage. Free, and the only way to save one before it dies. Sneak+Activate banks the whole army.
ability.awakened.command.desc: Aim at an enemy to send your whole army at it, or at the ground to make them hold that spot.
ability.awakened.mass_raise.desc: Raise a whole wave at once. It raises the loadout you set in the soul menu (G), or 5 of your active soul if you have not set one.
ability.awakened.possess.desc: Take control of a minion and pilot it. Cycle (V) hops to the next minion, Activate (R) warps your real body to it, sneak exits. Your body stays where you left it and can be attacked.
awakened.possess.controls: Piloting. WASD: move, mouse: aim, left/right click: attack (hold to keep attacking), F5: view, V: next, R: warp body, sneak: exit
awakened.possess.tether_lost: The minion went too far and was recalled. You are back in your body.
awakened.stone_mech.controls.title: Stone Mech
awakened.summon.upkeep_recall: Out of stamina. A minion was recalled.
awakened.summon.dimension_recall: Your minions stayed behind and went back to souls. Summon them again here.
awakened.summon.at_capacity: Army full (%s). Recall one, or raise your mastery for more.
awakened.souls.title: Souls
awakened.souls.subtitle: From mobs you kill
awakened.souls.empty: No souls yet. Kill any mob to get its soul.
awakened.souls.help: Left-click: active soul (Summon)  •  Scroll or [-]/[+]: wave count (Shift ×5)  •  Right-click: add all (Shift: clear)
awakened.souls.tip_active: What Summon raises when you press it
awakened.souls.tip_field: Minions out now / most you can have out
awakened.souls.tip_power: Bonus health and damage new minions get from mastery + Ability Power
awakened.souls.tip_wave: The mobs Mass Raise summons at once
awakened.souls.tip_lock: Stop kills from giving new souls
awakened.souls.tip_blacklist_btn: Manage mobs that never drop a soul
awakened.souls.power_none: vanilla, raise mastery or Ability Power
awakened.souls.d_all: Add all of a type  (Shift = clear)
awakened.souls.lock_hint: Locked: kills give no new souls
awakened.souls.blacklist_empty: No mobs blacklisted. Use the [Ø] handle on a soul to add one.
awakened.souls.blacklist_help: Blacklisted mobs never drop a soul, whatever kills them.
power.awakened.regenerator.desc: You heal without stopping, and your claws and abilities make the target Bleed, which heals you back. Adamantium mined below Y -16 and bonded in an Infusion Tank becomes permanent armour you keep through death.
awakened.regenerator.hint: You heal fast. Adamantium ore is in the Overworld below Y 0, most common around Y -40. Mine and smelt it, craft an Infusion Tank, and bond it to your skeleton.
ability.awakened.claw_strike.desc: Slash everything in front of you within about 3 blocks. Every one you hit heals you.
ability.awakened.rend.desc: A short-range execute. It hits up to 2.6 times as hard the closer the target is to dead, and heals you, more on a kill.
ability.awakened.predator_pounce.desc: Leap where you look and crash down. Enemies where you land are knocked back and weakened, and each one caught heals you. No fall damage.
ability.awakened.pin.desc: Tackle an enemy within 6 blocks and pin it down for up to 10 seconds. It can't move or be knocked free, and you rake it once a second, bleeding it and healing you.
ability.awakened.frenzy.desc: Roar for 8 seconds of Regeneration II, Strength, Resistance and Speed.
awakened.adamantium.maxed: Your skeleton is already fully bonded.
awakened.adamantium.title: Adamantium Bonded
awakened.adamantium.subtitle: Coating Tier %s
awakened.infusion.title: Adamantium Infusion Tank
awakened.infusion.benefits: Each tier gives armour, toughness, attack & knockback, kept through death.
awakened.infusion.not_ready: Needs a full tank and the Regenerator power.
awakened.infusion.not_regenerator: Only a Regenerator can bond adamantium.
awakened.infusion.need_charge: The tank needs a full adamantium charge.
awakened.infusion.need_more: Not enough adamantium: %s/%s. Pour in more ingots.
awakened.infusion.lie_ready: You are in the tank. Press Begin Infusion when ready.
power.awakened.pyrokinetic.desc: You throw fire, and every cast builds Heat, up to 30% more damage across the kit. Mastery raises your Heat ceiling, and burning your own health pushes past it.
ability.awakened.fireball.desc: Throw a fireball. It sets the target burning and bursts into flame where it lands.
ability.awakened.flame_beam.desc: Hold to pour fire from your palms into one beam, out to 20 blocks. Damage ramps up over 3 seconds and sets whatever it touches alight.
ability.awakened.barrage.desc: Hold to lob shells where you look, up to 30 blocks out. Each splits into six bomblets that burst and leave the ground burning for 5 seconds. Overshoots anything closer than 5 blocks. Drains 12 stamina a second.
ability.awakened.fire_jets.desc: Tap for a hard burst of thrust where you look, hold to keep thrusting. A tap costs 10 stamina, holding drains 12 a second.
ability.awakened.backdraft.desc: Pull the air out of 12 blocks around you for two seconds: fires go out and enemies are dragged toward you. Then it reignites in one blast, stronger for every fire put out.
awakened.pyrokinetic.barrage.no_ground: Nothing down there to lob at
awakened.pyrokinetic.barrage.too_close: Too close to lob. The shells fly over
awakened.pyrokinetic.hint.overdrive: Your Heat is past the white mark on the bar. It burns you while it stays there, and only drops back once you stop casting.
awakened.pyrokinetic.hint.blue: Your flame burns blue. More Heat means more damage, up to 30% at a full bar.
power.awakened.storm_caller.desc: Call lightning down out of the sky. It starts on one target at a time and spreads to whole areas as you master it.
ability.awakened.lightning_strike.desc: Charge briefly, then call a bolt down on what you're aiming at. It follows a target that moves.
ability.awakened.tesla_beam.desc: Hold to fire a beam of lightning from your hand, out to 18 blocks.
ability.awakened.updraft.desc: Press to rise on a storm cloud and fly for as long as your stamina lasts.
ability.awakened.thunderfall.desc: Press to blast into the sky, then press again to crash onto where you're aiming. It fires on its own after 5 seconds, and sneak cancels. Needs open sky above you.
awakened.stormcaller.no_sky: No open sky above to launch into
awakened.stormcaller.thunderfall_aim: Look down to mark your strike. Left-click or press again to fall, Shift to cancel
ability.awakened.tempest.desc: Summon a storm around you for 6 seconds. It repeatedly calls lightning down on enemies within 10 blocks.
power.awakened.graviton.desc: Control gravity. G makes you heavier, Shift+G lighter, and holding G resets your weight. Light jumps higher and falls softer. Heavy shrugs off knockback and sinks in water.
ability.awakened.heavy_hand.desc: Tap to yank a creature up to 24 blocks away over to you, hold to slam it into the ground and pin it. With Shift, a tap shoves it away and a hold launches it about 12 blocks up.
ability.awakened.gravity_well.desc: Summon a small planet up to 50 blocks away and fall to it, safe from fall damage. Press again mid-fall to summon the next and keep your speed. Press on arrival or sneak to let go.
awakened.graviton.well_no_room: No room for a well there
ability.awakened.weightless.desc: Aim within 24 blocks, or hold to preview. Creatures within 5 blocks float for 3 seconds (players 1.5), cannot attack and fly when hit, then drop and take fall damage. Mastery lifts them higher.
ability.awakened.dense.desc: Hold to become immovable and take 60% less damage. Hostile mobs within 10 blocks come for you. Release to send the damage you absorbed back out as a shockwave.
ability.awakened.event_horizon.desc: Open a black hole where you aim for 6 seconds. It pulls in everything within 16 blocks and erases mobs with 30 health or less at its core. Your stamina does not refill until it collapses.
power.awakened.chronokinetic.desc: Bend time. Freeze enemies out of time, blur clear of danger, and wind the day forward or back.
ability.awakened.time_shift.desc: Hold to sweep the world's time forward, faster the longer you hold. Hold Sneak as you activate to wind the day backward instead.
ability.awakened.flicker.desc: Blur a short distance where you look, with brief invulnerability and no fall damage. You have to already be moving.
ability.awakened.stasis.desc: Freeze the enemy under your crosshair for 3 seconds, up to 5 with mastery and Ability Power. It still takes damage normally. You can hold one at a time, plus one more per point of Ability Power.
ability.awakened.rewind.desc: Aim at a creature to snap it back to where it stood 3 seconds ago; players get their health back too. Crouch instead to rewind your own position and damage.
ability.awakened.time_stop.desc: Freeze every enemy and arrow within 18 blocks until you press again, up to 8 seconds; they still take damage. You move faster while it drains stamina. Catching an enemy player freezes your team too.
awakened.graviton.no_spot: Nothing in range to aim at
awakened.graviton.horizon_busy: One black hole at a time
awakened.graviton.weightless_caught: You are weightless and cannot attack
awakened.graviton.weight_float_hint: Shift+%s to get lighter and float up

quest.awakened.regenerator_12.desc: Kill %s enemies while Pin holds them down. Pin unlocks at mastery 7.

quest.awakened.regenerator_16.desc: Kill %s more enemies with the Bleed alone.

quest.awakened.spider_15.desc: Reach Spider mastery %s. Unlocks Wall, the last web type. You need the Web Gauntlets to load it.

quest.awakened.reaper_12.title: Under the Stone
quest.awakened.reaper_12.desc: Find %2$s. Eyes of ender point the way.
quest.awakened.reaper_13.title: Five Hundred Souls
quest.awakened.reaper_13.desc: Carry a %2$s. Pour 500 banked souls into a Soul Vessel to make one.
quest.awakened.reaper_14.title: Condemned
quest.awakened.reaper_14.desc: Kill %s enemies you marked with Death Mark. It unlocks at mastery 10.
quest.awakened.reaper_15.title: The Whole Kit
quest.awakened.reaper_15.desc: Reach Reaper mastery %s. Unlocks Death Mark.
quest.awakened.reaper_16.title: The Scythe
quest.awakened.reaper_16.desc: Carry the %2$s. It takes a Scythe Edge, 3 bones, a wither skeleton skull and a Soul Core.

quest.awakened.geokinetic_6.desc: Raise %s more rocks with Rock Throw.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_7.title: Stop the Charge
quest.awakened.geokinetic_7.desc: Kill %1$s %2$s. They only charge in a straight line, so raise a pillar in front of one.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_8.title: Deep Stone
quest.awakened.geokinetic_9.title: Under the Hammer
quest.awakened.geokinetic_9.desc: Kill %s enemies while the Great Maul has them pinned. It unlocks at mastery 7.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_10.title: The Arch-Evoker
quest.awakened.geokinetic_10.desc: Kill %2$s. It spawns in the Evoker's Spire.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_11.title: Sunken Vault
quest.awakened.geokinetic_12.title: Pinned Down
quest.awakened.geokinetic_12.desc: Kill %s enemies pinned under the Great Maul.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_13.title: Golem Rout
quest.awakened.geokinetic_13.desc: Kill %s enemies with the Stone Mech's own fist or ground pound.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_14.title: Stonelord
quest.awakened.geokinetic_14.desc: Reach Geokinetic mastery %s. Unlocks the Stone Mech.
quest.awakened.geokinetic_15.title: First March
quest.awakened.geokinetic_15.desc: Kill something with the Stone Mech's own fist or ground pound.
quest.awakened.exosavant_1.title: Field Test
quest.awakened.exosavant_1.desc: Land %s hits. The suit does not have to be on.
quest.awakened.exosavant_2.title: Live Fire
quest.awakened.exosavant_3.title: Propellant
quest.awakened.exosavant_3.desc: Carry %1$s %2$s. The Gauntlets and the Boots both need it.
quest.awakened.exosavant_4.title: First Build
quest.awakened.exosavant_4.desc: Get the %2$s. Wearing them counts, and the Rocket needs them.
quest.awakened.exosavant_5.title: Under Fire
quest.awakened.exosavant_5.desc: Take %s hits of 3 hearts or more while the suit is on. Only hits from enemies count, not falls or fire.
quest.awakened.exosavant_6.title: Sustained Fire
quest.awakened.exosavant_6.desc: Fire the Rocket %s times. Needs the suit on and the Gauntlets equipped.
quest.awakened.exosavant_7.title: Fuel Line
quest.awakened.exosavant_7.desc: Kill %1$s %2$s. They spawn in nether fortresses, and their powder goes into the Leggings.
quest.awakened.exosavant_8.title: Supply Run
quest.awakened.exosavant_9.title: Target Acquired
quest.awakened.exosavant_9.desc: Kill %s enemies you had already tagged. Scan Pulse unlocks at mastery 7.
quest.awakened.exosavant_10.title: Sensor Optics
quest.awakened.exosavant_10.desc: Carry %s amethyst shards. The Leggings and the Helmet both need them.
quest.awakened.exosavant_11.title: Fire Mission
quest.awakened.exosavant_11.desc: Kill %2$s. It spawns inside the Evoker's Spire.
quest.awakened.exosavant_12.title: Ancient Alloy
quest.awakened.exosavant_13.title: Air Superiority
quest.awakened.exosavant_13.desc: Kill %s enemies while the thrusters are carrying you. Flight unlocks at mastery 8.
quest.awakened.exosavant_14.title: Reactor Grade
quest.awakened.exosavant_14.desc: Carry %s netherite ingots. The Helmet and the Core both need one.
quest.awakened.exosavant_15.title: Take Off
quest.awakened.exosavant_15.desc: Reach Exosavant mastery %s. Unlocks flight, once you have the Boots and the Leggings.
quest.awakened.exosavant_16.title: Core Online
quest.awakened.exosavant_16.desc: Reach Exosavant mastery %s. The Core unlocks the Artillery Barrage and the Failsafe.
quest.awakened.gamma_1.title: Heavy Hands
quest.awakened.gamma_1.desc: Land %s hits. Thunderclap is your first move that counts.
quest.awakened.gamma_2.title: Something to Break
quest.awakened.gamma_3.title: Pocket Rocks
quest.awakened.gamma_4.title: Psych Up
quest.awakened.gamma_5.title: Thick Skin
quest.awakened.gamma_5.desc: Take %s hits with your Rage at Enraged or higher. Only hits from enemies count, not falls or fire.
quest.awakened.gamma_6.title: Deep Fury
quest.awakened.gamma_7.title: Hoglin Hunt
quest.awakened.gamma_7.desc: Kill %1$s %2$s. They spawn in crimson forests and charge on sight.
quest.awakened.gamma_8.title: High Ground
quest.awakened.gamma_9.title: Ragdoll
quest.awakened.gamma_9.desc: Carry %s enemies through a full Ragdoll Slam without losing your grip. It unlocks at mastery 10.
quest.awakened.gamma_10.title: Ground Zero
quest.awakened.gamma_10.desc: Land %s Smash Leaps that catch two or more enemies in the same crater. It unlocks at mastery 5.
quest.awakened.gamma_11.title: The Wither
quest.awakened.gamma_11.desc: Kill the %2$s. You have to build one first.
quest.awakened.gamma_12.title: Bastion Breaker
quest.awakened.gamma_13.title: Top of the Meter
quest.awakened.gamma_13.desc: Push your Rage to the top of the meter %s times. Only a hit from an enemy takes it there, not a fall or fire.
quest.awakened.gamma_14.title: Pounded Flat
quest.awakened.gamma_14.desc: Carry %s more enemies through a full Ragdoll Slam without losing your grip.
quest.awakened.gamma_15.title: Long Way Down
quest.awakened.gamma_15.desc: Reach Gamma mastery %s. Unlocks Smash Leap.
quest.awakened.gamma_16.title: Unstoppable
quest.awakened.gamma_16.desc: Reach Gamma mastery %s. Unlocks Ragdoll Slam, and Provoke can then take you to the top of the meter.

quest.awakened.phytokinetic_2.title: Overgrown

quest.awakened.phytokinetic_4.title: Plant the Seed
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_4.desc: Cast Sunflower Field %s times. It unlocks at mastery 3 and needs ground under your crosshair.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_5.title: Pulled Through
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_5.desc: Anchor a Vine Grapple in leaves or logs %s times. It unlocks at mastery 5.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_6.title: Standing Garden
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_7.title: Swamp Hunt
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_7.desc: Kill %1$s %2$s. They spawn in swamps and mangrove swamps.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_8.title: Sunflower Plains
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_9.title: Held Fast
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_9.desc: Kill %s enemies while Ivy Wrap still holds them.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_10.title: Deep Roots
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_11.title: The Arch-Evoker
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_11.desc: Kill %2$s. It spawns in the Evoker's Spire, on high ground above the treeline.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_12.title: Green Over Stone
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_13.title: Held in Bark
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_13.desc: Kill %s enemies while Ivy Wrap still holds them.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_14.title: The Whole Garden
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_14.desc: Reach Phytokinetic mastery %s. Unlocks Cradle of Roots.
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_15.title: Last Resort
quest.awakened.phytokinetic_15.desc: Cradle a player who is under 35% health %s times. Cradling yourself counts.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_1.title: Throw Your Weight
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_2.title: Off Your Feet
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_2.desc: Land %s hits. Woosh only counts when it shoves two enemies at once or swats a shot out of the air.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_3.title: Bag of Feathers
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_4.title: Blown Over
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_5.title: Return to Sender
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_5.desc: Swat enemy fire out of the air with %s Wooshes. One gust counts once, however many shots it catches.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_6.title: Clear the Sky
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_6.desc: Kill %1$s phantoms. They only spawn once you have gone three nights without sleeping.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_7.title: Downwind
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_8.title: Windswept Hills
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_9.title: Pressure Front
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_10.title: Phantom Membranes
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_10.desc: Carry %1$s phantom membranes. Phantoms drop them.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_11.title: Scatter Them
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_11.desc: Land %s Tornadoes that each throw 3 or more enemies.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_12.title: Breeze Hunt
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_12.desc: Kill %1$s breezes. They spawn in trial chambers.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_13.title: The Quiet
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_13.desc: Catch %s enemies in Air Removal. Each one counts once per dome.

quest.awakened.aerokinetic_14.desc: Land %s Tornadoes that each throw 3 or more enemies.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_15.title: Through the Line
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_15.desc: Land %s crescents that each cut through two enemies. Air Cut only pierces from mastery 12.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_16.title: Take the Air Away
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_16.desc: Reach Aerokinetic mastery %s. Unlocks Air Removal.
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_17.title: True Flight
quest.awakened.aerokinetic_17.desc: Reach Aerokinetic mastery %s. Gale Winds becomes real flight and Air Cut starts piercing.
power.awakened.hydrokinetic.desc: Command water. Your abilities always work, and hit 25% harder in rain, standing in water, near a body of water (12 blocks), or while you carry a filled vessel. The Nether is always dry. You never drown and always have Dolphin's Grace.
ability.awakened.water_lance.desc: Form a water lance and throw it where you look. It arcs like a thrown trident. A tap pierces one enemy, a full 2 second draw pierces four.
ability.awakened.geyser.desc: Erupt a column of water. Aim at an enemy within 12 blocks to hit it and throw it into the air, or sneak or look down to ride the column up yourself.
ability.awakened.wave_rider.desc: Hold to surf a crest of water that follows the terrain, faster over water or in rain. Let go to step off. Drains 6 stamina a second, and about one vessel charge a second away from water.
ability.awakened.tide_hook.desc: Extend a stream of water up to 22 blocks. Aim at terrain to reel yourself there, or at an enemy to hold it floating. Attack to fling it, scroll to move it.
ability.awakened.tsunami.desc: Hold to pour, release to roll a wall of water that carries everything in its path. The longer you pour, the bigger the wave, up to 56 blocks long and 28 wide, 15% more when wet.
awakened.hydrokinetic.geyser_aim: Aim at an enemy, or sneak or look down to launch yourself
awakened.hydrokinetic.hint: Water makes your abilities hit 25% harder. Carry a vessel to keep the bonus away from water, and right-click water to fill it. Each tier holds more: Water Flask → Water Canteen → Water Reservoir → Tidal Vessel → Reservoir Core.
item.awakened.vessel.fill: Right-click a water source to fill.
power.awakened.pocket.desc: Portals move you and your enemies around the fight. You can also step into your own rift dimension, or throw an enemy into it.
ability.awakened.rift.desc: Open a doorway and walk into your own rift dimension, or aim at an enemy within 5 blocks to send it there instead. Sneak+Activate opens your Rift Stash, free. Walking in costs a full base stamina bar, sending an enemy costs half of one.
ability.awakened.pocket_blink.desc: Teleport to exactly where you aim, up to 14 blocks. No fall damage on arrival, and half a second of invulnerability.
ability.awakened.recursive_drop.desc: Open a portal under an enemy up to 22 blocks away and loop it through the floor 8 times, hit on every pass and pinned in place the whole time.
ability.awakened.surface.desc: Tear a rift straight up and step out at the highest safe point above you.
ability.awakened.domain_expansion.desc: Seal a 9 block dome around you, up to 20 with Ability Power, that nobody can leave. Players and NPCs inside lose their powers. Mobs take damage and lose you past 7 blocks. Drains 9 stamina a second.
awakened.pocket.rift_open: A rift opens. Step through to enter
awakened.pocket.rift_return: A return rift opens. Step through to leave
awakened.pocket.evicted: Cast %s back out of the dimension
awakened.pocket.domain_open: Domain Expansion. The area is sealed
power.awakened.nuclear.desc: Taking hits builds Heat. A full bar detonates, hitting everything within 5 blocks and leaving a fallout cloud. You take none of it.
ability.awakened.cluster_burst.desc: Spray ten small blasts through a cone 9 blocks ahead of you. Each bursts within about 2 blocks of where it lands.
ability.awakened.explosive_dash.desc: Fire a blast behind you and ride the recoil forward. Hold to keep dashing. Costs 6 stamina, then 3.5 per dash while held.
ability.awakened.howitzer.desc: Hold to charge a shell, then fire an instant beam that detonates where it lands. A full 1.6 second charge reaches 64 blocks.
ability.awakened.excavate.desc: Blast a sphere of stone, dirt, gravel, sand and magma where you aim and drop it as items. Hold to keep drilling forward. Never breaks ores or builds.
ability.awakened.nuke.desc: Hold for 2.5 seconds to throw a nuke that hits everything within 9 blocks and leaves fallout for 12 seconds. It drains stamina as it charges. Letting go or getting hit calls it off.
power.awakened.gamma.desc: You get stronger the angrier you are. Fighting builds Rage, and your size, health and damage all scale off that one meter. Walk away and you cool down.
ability.awakened.gamma_provoke.desc: Hold to fill your own Rage. Costs 57 stamina a second, and mastery raises the ceiling from Simmering at first to the full meter at 10.
ability.awakened.gamma_provoke.capped: Provoke cannot raise your Rage any higher yet.
ability.awakened.gamma_thunderclap.desc: Clap your hands to send a shockwave through the cone in front of you. Damage, reach and knockback all grow with your Rage.
ability.awakened.gamma_leap.desc: Hold to load a jump, release to launch along your aim. You take no fall damage. Landing drops a shockwave that grows with the drop and with your Rage.
ability.awakened.gamma_boulder.desc: Press to rip a boulder out of the ground, release to throw it where you look. Damage and knockback both scale with your Rage. You must be on the ground to start it.
ability.awakened.gamma_slam.desc: Grab an enemy within 6 blocks and pound them into the ground four times, then throw them down. Rage scales every impact, and bosses take it at full strength.
ability.awakened.gamma_boulder.airborne: You need solid ground to rip a boulder.
ability.awakened.gamma_slam.no_target: No one in reach to grab.
power.awakened.aerokinetic.desc: Control the air. Wind shoves enemies and their arrows around, and you take less fall damage. Flight unlocks at mastery 12.
ability.awakened.aero_woosh.desc: Blast a cone of wind ahead of you. Knocks enemies back and scatters incoming projectiles.
ability.awakened.aero_gale_winds.desc: Press to leap where you look. From mastery 5, hold the key in the air to ride the wind or tap for a burst dash. From mastery 12 arm True Flight with your secondary ability key, then double-tap Space to fly.
ability.awakened.aero_air_cut.desc: Fire a crescent of wind out to 40 blocks. From mastery 12 it cuts through everything in line.
ability.awakened.aero_tornado.desc: Drop a 12 block tall funnel where you aim, up to 20 blocks out. It drags in everything nearby and holds it for 5 seconds, then flings it out. You can ride your own funnel.
ability.awakened.aero_air_removal.desc: Pull the air out of a dome where you aim, for 12 seconds. Everyone but you suffocates, armor or not, creeper fuses stall, and spellcasters cannot finish a cast.
awakened.aero.flight_armed: True Flight armed. Double-tap Space to take off
awakened.aero.flight_hint: Flight tip: press [%s] to arm True Flight, then double-tap Space to take off. Space rises, Shift descends.
awakened.nominate.first: Enjoying The Awakening? Nominate it for CurseForge's Mod of the Year. It takes 30 seconds.
awakened.nominate.creative: Having fun with the powers? Nominate The Awakening for CurseForge's Mod of the Year. It takes 30 seconds.
awakened.nominate.second: Still having fun? A Mod of the Year nomination takes 30 seconds and helps The Awakening a lot.
awakened.nominate.last: Last chance: nominations for Mod of the Year close on November 9.
awakened.nominate.button_tip: Open the nomination form and copy our CurseForge link
awakened.nominate.stopped: Got it. No more nomination reminders.
awakened.nominate.closed: Mod of the Year nominations have closed. Thanks for playing!
awakened.nominate.card: Nominate us for Mod of the Year
awakened.nominate.copied: Our CurseForge link is copied. Paste it into the form, with the name The Awakening and your email.
awakened.nominate.pause_tip: For CurseForge's Mod of the Year 2026. Opens the form and copies our CurseForge link.
power.awakened.scaler.desc: Change your size across seven stages, from a 0.1× Speck to a 5× Colossus. Mastery unlocks the smallest and largest stages.
ability.awakened.size_change.desc: Activate to grow one size stage, Shift+Activate to shrink one. Costs 3 stamina a shift, and growing needs the headroom for it. Run dry and you snap back toward normal.
ability.awakened.mass_leap.desc: Hold to charge, release to leap where you look. The smaller your stage the further you fly, with no fall damage. Crouch while charging to squash flat, which throws you further and fits you through gaps.
ability.awakened.hitch_stomp.desc: Small or under: latch onto anything bigger and ride it, unnoticed only as a Speck. Brute or bigger: slam the ground for damage that grows with your stage and your fall height.
ability.awakened.scale_ray.desc: Activate to grow the creature you aim at, Shift+Activate to shrink it, up to two stages either way for 15 seconds. Grown targets hit harder, shrunk ones weaker. Works on allies.
ability.awakened.clamber_seize.desc: Small or under: dash onto a bigger enemy and hit it several times. Brute or bigger: grab a much smaller creature in your fist, then left click to throw it.
awakened.scaler.hint: Activate to grow a stage, Shift+Activate to shrink
awakened.scaler.no_room: Not enough room to grow here
awakened.scaler.exhausted: Out of stamina. You snap back.
awakened.scaler.too_big_to_hitch: You need something bigger than you to ride
awakened.scaler.player_notices: Only a speck can ride a player unnoticed
awakened.scaler.ray_at_cap: They can't be resized any further
awakened.scaler.no_room_target: No room for them to grow there
awakened.scaler.ray_hint: Resized. Mash jump to fight it off
awakened.scaler.clamber_no_target: Nothing within reach to clamber onto
awakened.scaler.clamber_too_small: You need something bigger to clamber over
awakened.scaler.seize_taken: Already caught in someone else's fist
awakened.scaler.hitch_no_target: Nothing within reach to hitch onto
awakened.scaler.stomp_busy: The stomp is already winding up
awakened.scaler.leap_busy: Spring already loaded. Release to launch.
awakened.scaler.commit_utility: Hitch needs Small or below, Stomp needs Brute or above.
awakened.scaler.commit_violent: Clamber needs Small or below, Seize needs Brute or above.
awakened.scaler.clamber_warning: Something tiny is crawling on you. Crouch repeatedly to shake it off.
awakened.scaler.seize_too_big: Too big to fit in your fist
awakened.scaler.seized_hint: Seized. Mash jump to break free
awakened.scaler.escaped: They broke out of your grip.
item.awakened.containment_jar.tooltip: Holds a creature shrunk to a quarter size or less. Right-click it to catch it, right-click again to let it out; it grows back soon after. Only a Scaler can shrink things.
awakened.scaler.jar_taken: Already held in a fist or another jar
awakened.scaler.jarred_hint: Jarred. Mash jump to break out
awakened.scaler.jar_escaped: They broke out of your jar.
awakened.scaler.jar_gone: The jar is empty. They got away.
power.awakened.reaper.desc: Every kill banks souls, and your souls are a permanent power tier. A new Reaper has 5 hearts and hits for half damage. A maxed one has 20 hearts, six times the damage and triple the stamina.
ability.awakened.soul_bolt.desc: Tap to fire a homing soul wisp. Hold to charge a volley, looking at enemies to paint up to 8 targets, then release to split the wisps across them. Costs stamina, never souls.
ability.awakened.spectral_drift.desc: Dissolve into smoke and flow 8 blocks along your aim, passing through walls. Nothing can touch you until you reform.
ability.awakened.soul_tether.desc: Chain the enemy you're aiming at and drain its health for 5 seconds, healing you for 60% of what you drain. The chain breaks past 12 blocks or when you lose sight of it.
ability.awakened.wailing_souls.desc: Send spirits onto an enemy up to 16 blocks away. For 6 seconds they damage it and blur its vision.
ability.awakened.death_mark.desc: Brand an enemy up to 16 blocks away. It takes 25% more damage from every source for 12 to 20 seconds. Kill it yourself for bonus souls and the mark jumps to the nearest enemy.
awakened.reaper.aura_hint: Move to set how much others see · release G to confirm
awakened.reaper.tether_no_target: No creature within reach to tether
awakened.reaper.haunt_no_target: No creature within reach to haunt
awakened.reaper.mark_no_target: No creature within reach to mark
power.awakened.exosavant.desc: You build a powered exo-suit piece by piece as mastery unlocks each part, until you can summon the whole suit at will.
ability.awakened.rocket.desc: Fire a rocket from your forearm. It explodes on impact with hard knockback. Needs the Gauntlets.
ability.awakened.rocket_charge.desc: Fire your thrusters for a hard dash where you look. Needs the Boots. While flying it switches jet cruise on or off instead, for free.
ability.awakened.chest_beam.desc: Hold to fire a laser from your chest. It pierces everything in line out to 24 blocks. Needs the Chestplate.
ability.awakened.scan_pulse.desc: Fire a scan wave through walls out to 48 blocks, tagging everything it can attack for 9 seconds. Your Rocket homes onto tagged targets and your suit hits them 35% harder. Needs the Leggings.
ability.awakened.artillery_barrage.desc: Shell a spot up to 40 blocks away with 24 rounds over 2.5 seconds, scattered across 5 blocks. Hits scanned enemies 35% harder. Costs 45 stamina.
awakened.exosavant.flight_hint: Flight tip: while flying, select Rocket Charge and press [%s] to switch Free Flight ⇄ Jet. Set your default in the Suit Controls wheel [%s].

ability.awakened.sunflower_field.desc: Plant a patch of sunflowers where you aim, up to 12 blocks out. For 9 seconds it heals any player within 4 blocks, you included.
ability.awakened.vine_grapple.desc: Fire a vine at what you're looking at, up to 20 blocks, and reel yourself in. Leaves and logs reel faster and throw you forward as you arrive.
ability.awakened.life_graft.desc: Hold to drain health out of what you aim at, or hold Sneak to feed them yours instead. Costs 6 stamina a second, and it snaps at 12 blocks.
ability.awakened.cradle_of_roots.desc: Cocoon an ally within 12 blocks to heal and shield them, then pull them to you. Sneak+Activate to cocoon yourself.

power.awakened.brawler.desc: You fight with bare fists. Your moves leave an enemy airborne, flat or pinned, and the kit does more damage to a body in that state, most of all when a different move put it there. Hits build a combo worth up to 15% more damage.
ability.awakened.brawler_rising_hook.des: Punch upward into whatever is in front of you. The enemy is launched and hangs there for you to keep hitting. Jump or look up as you press to rise with it. A low ceiling turns the launch into a slam.
ability.awakened.brawler_sledge_drop.des: Everything in the cone ahead is smashed flat, and anything else within 3.5 blocks is shoved back and pinned. With an enemy hanging in the air you leap up and spike it down for 90% more damage.
You shoulder forward, steering the whole way. Tap for a short dash or hold to keep going. Nothing can hit you as you set off, and the first enemy you reach is carried along, into a wall if one is close when you stop.
ability.awakened.brawler_reel_in.desc: Your arm shoots out 8 blocks, hooks the enemy you look at through cover and yanks it to your feet, pinned. A second enemy beside it comes too, and the yank interrupts what it was winding up.
ability.awakened.brawler_full_counter.de: Press to guard for a moment. Anything that hits you then is sent back: melee at double damage, arrows at the archer, explosions at half. Costs 16 stamina, caught or not.

power.awakened.command.desc: Write the rules and the world follows them. Five slots, one sentence each: who it is about, what is true of them, how strong and how long. One runs at once, two from mastery 5, three from mastery 9. What a running rule paid cannot regenerate until it lets go.
ability.awakened.rule_1.desc: Switch the first slot on or off. A rule about what you hit, what hits you or what you look at pays for every body it takes. Any other rule pays once, when you switch it on.
ability.awakened.rule_2.desc: Switch the second slot on or off. Until mastery 5 only one rule runs at once, so this one is a spare to swap in.
ability.awakened.rule_3.desc: Switch the third slot on or off. Unlocking it lets two rules run at once.
ability.awakened.rule_4.desc: Switch the fourth slot on or off. A fourth written rule is a spare: switch one of the others off to run it.
ability.awakened.rule_5.desc: Switch the fifth slot on or off. Unlocking it lets three rules run at once.
awakened.command.target.me.desc: The rule is about you and nobody else.
awakened.command.target.what_i_hit.desc: The next body you hit with melee, an arrow or a thrown item. The rule runs its time on that body.
awakened.command.target.what_hits_me.des: Whatever damages you next. The rule lands on it the moment it connects.
awakened.command.target.mobs_near_me.des: Everything alive around you, picked again every tick. Its second number is how far it reaches, in blocks.
awakened.command.target.what_i_ride.desc: The animal you are riding. Get off and the rule lets go of it until you climb back on.
awakened.command.target.what_i_look_at.d: Whatever is under your crosshair, up to 32 blocks, except your own pets, summons and mount. Every body your look lands on pays the price and runs its own time, like a hit.
Every mob within 32 blocks that is after you. A mob that gives up the chase drops out, and one that starts it joins in.
awakened.command.effect.sees_in_the_dark: Night Vision for as long as the rule holds. Works on players only.
awakened.command.effect.breathes_water.d: Water Breathing for as long as the rule holds.
awakened.command.effect.jumps_higher.des: Jump Boost. The number is the tier, so 5 is Jump Boost V.
awakened.command.effect.burns.desc: Sets the body alight and keeps relighting it while the rule holds. Anything immune to fire is not affected, and the fire goes out when the rule ends.
awakened.command.effect.moves_at.desc: Speed. The number is the tier, so 3 is Speed III.
awakened.command.effect.is_stronger.desc: Strength. The number is the tier, so 2 is Strength II.
awakened.command.effect.weighs_nothing.d: Gravity stops once the body leaves the ground: a jump keeps rising, a hit sends it floating, and it keeps the speed it had. Sneak to sink slowly, with no fall damage.
awakened.command.effect.cannot_move.desc: Freezes the body in place while the rule holds. A player is held for half as long.
awakened.command.effect.is_weaker.desc: Weakness. Each tier of the number takes 4 off every melee hit. Arrows, spells and blasts hit as hard as before.
awakened.command.effect.regenerates.desc: Heals half a health a second for each point of the number.
awakened.command.effect.is_pushed.desc: Shoved away from you a little every tick the rule is live. The number is how hard. Does nothing to what you ride.
awakened.command.effect.is_pulled.desc: Pulled toward you a little every tick the rule is live. The number is how hard. Does nothing to what you ride.
awakened.command.effect.is_unseen.desc: Invisibility. Armour and anything held still give a body away.
awakened.command.effect.moves_where_i_lo: Hold forward to fly the way you look. Speed 1 is about twice a sprint. Said about anything else, it carries that body where you look, at twice the price.
awakened.command.effect.cannot_hurt_me.d: Whatever the rule has hold of can no longer damage you. It can still move, swing and hurt anyone else.
awakened.command.effect.digs_faster.desc: Haste. The number is the tier, so 2 is Haste II. Works on players only.
awakened.command.effect.lands_softly.des: No fall damage while the rule holds.
awakened.command.effect.glows.desc: An outline that shows through walls, even on a body that is unseen.
awakened.command.effect.weighs_a_ton.des: Each point of the number adds the body's weight again, so 1 falls twice as hard. It falls fast and barely jumps. Fliers are dragged down too.
Adds the number in blocks to how far a player can hit, mine and use things. Does nothing on mobs.
awakened.command.effect.feels_my_pain.de: Whenever you take damage, whatever the rule has hold of takes the same amount.
awakened.command.effect.is_lit_up.desc: A light at the body's head that goes where it goes.
awakened.command.effect.gathers.desc: Dropped items and experience drift to the body. The number is how far away they are pulled from, in blocks.
Still water and lava hold the body up like ground. Sneak to sink, and let go to come back up.
awakened.command.effect.swaps_with_me.de: You and the body trade places the moment the rule takes hold. Exact spots, even mid-air or over lava.
awakened.command.effect.returns_here.des: When the rule lets go, the body is put back where it was taken, even in mid-air, with no fall damage. On you or around you, a trigger going false lets go too. Not after death or a dimension change.
awakened.command.effect.bleeds.desc: Loses the number in health every second, straight through armour.
awakened.command.effect.hurts_when_it_mo: Loses half a health per block it travels for each point of the number, however it moves: walking, falling or pushed by another rule.
awakened.command.effect.is_fragile.desc: Takes 20% more damage per point of the number, from everything. If two rules make it fragile, only the bigger one counts.
awakened.command.effect.explodes.desc: Goes off when the rule takes hold: the number in health to everything within 3 blocks, and a shove away. On mobs near you it goes off again every 2 seconds. Never hurts you, your team or blocks.
awakened.command.trigger.always.desc: Live the whole time the slot is on.
Live only while you hold sneak. Let go and a rule on you or around you pauses until you crouch again. A rule that already landed on a body runs its time out.
Live only while your feet are off the ground. On a mount, while its feet are.
awakened.command.trigger.while_standing_: Live only once you have stood still for a second and a half, with no movement key held. The moment you move it goes dead and the count starts over.
awakened.command.trigger.at_night.desc: Live only from dusk to dawn by the clock, so never in the Nether or the End.
awakened.command.trigger.below_half_heal: Live only while you are under half your hearts.
awakened.command.trigger.while_sprinting: Live only while you sprint, on foot or on a camel.
awakened.command.trigger.underground.des: Live only while your head cannot see the sky. A roof or thick leaves count, and so do the Nether and the End. Open water over your head does not.
awakened.command.trigger.while_falling.d: Live only while you are dropping through the air. The rise of a jump does not count.
awakened.command.trigger.just_after_i_hi: Live for 3 seconds after one of your hits lands, melee or ranged. On a what I hit rule, it is the second hit that lands the rule.
awakened.command.trigger.after_i_kill.de: Live for 4 seconds after you kill something.

power.awakened.limitless.desc: Infinity stops hits and shots just short of you, paying a point of stamina per point of damage. Explosions get through. Six Eyes shows living things within 24 blocks through walls. Tap G to turn Six Eyes on or off, or hold G to switch either one.
ability.awakened.limitless_void.desc: A 24-wide sphere hides the world and paralyzes every enemy inside until it closes. Everyone floats (jump to rise, sneak to sink). Its drain climbs every second. Grows with mastery and Ability Power.
awakened.limitless.void_overlap: Too close to another Infinite Void
ability.awakened.limitless_blue.desc: Tap: an orb on what you aim at pulls mobs, items and arrows within 8 blocks into a clump that implodes after 2 s. Red blasts it apart. Hold: pulls you up to 20 blocks, chaining in mid-air.
ability.awakened.limitless_red.desc: Fires a red orb up to 16 blocks that bursts on what it hits, throwing that body far and anything within 3 blocks away. A Blue clump takes double damage. Shift: bursts point blank to launch you.
ability.awakened.limitless_purple.desc: Hold 2.5 s, then let go to fire a 6-wide sphere that erases blocks, items and shots for 60 blocks and hits all it passes. Holes close after 10 s. From mastery 8, hold 2 s more for a 10-wide one.
awakened.screen.setting_limitless_infini: Stop hits and shots just short of you. Each blocked hit costs as much stamina as the damage it would have done. Explosions get through.
awakened.screen.setting_limitless_six_ey: See living things within 24 blocks through walls.
awakened.limitless.blue_cannot_pull: Can't pull yourself while flying or riding
ability.awakened.limitless_rct.desc: Hold to heal. The press also puts out fire and clears poison and wither. While healing you can't sprint, attack or use items, but you can still mine. Heals faster with mastery and Ability Power.
power.awakened.ruin.desc: Whatever you touch rots. Your melee hits and abilities put Decay stacks on enemies, with no cap. Every stack does damage each second, and they all drop off 8 seconds after the last new one lands.
ability.awakened.ruin_grip.desc: Hold to grab the enemy in front of you and pin it in place, bosses included. It gains stacks every half second. Grabbing the same enemy again takes as long as you held it.
ability.awakened.ruin_spread.desc: Slam your palm and rot tears 14 blocks ahead along the ground. Enemies on it get 3 stacks, then one every half second they stay, until it fades 4 s later. Reach grows with mastery and Ability Power.
ability.awakened.ruin_rush.desc: Hold to dash low, taking half damage. Run into the enemy you aim at to drag it, 1 stack every half second. Slam it into a wall for 10 stacks and a hit that grows with them. A movement key stops you.
ability.awakened.ruin_breach.desc: Rot a 3x3 hole up to 8 deep into the wall or floor you look at, or a pit that sinks an enemy with 2 stacks. Hold to bore a tunnel where you look. Holes close after 10 seconds.
ability.awakened.ruin_collapse.desc: Slam the ground into a crater 32 blocks wide, 96 at full mastery, trees and houses too. Enemies on it get 10 stacks and a landing hit that grows with them. You stay on a pillar. 30 second cooldown.
